WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
above_average_status AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.rfistat,
    sa.status_avg,
    os.overall_avg
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE sa.status_avg > os.overall_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_qualifying
  FROM above_average_status
)
SELECT 
  aas.rfistat as rfi_status,
  aas.status_avg as avg_modindex,
  aas.status_avg - aas.overall_avg as above_overall_avg,
  aas.status_avg - qm.mean_qualifying as diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM above_average_status aas
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
ORDER BY aas.rfistat
